query_construction: first 32 alphanumeric facts-only terms in source order; retained after the one permitted TF-IDF salient-term corrective attempt reached 3/9 authorities at k=100 and 4/9 at k=500, below the predeclared majority-of-nine adoption threshold
redundancy_rule: select at most one chunk per source_id
ordering: descending BM25 score; retain original retrieval rank as deterministic tie-breaker
rationale: A small, source-diverse evidence set is easier to inspect and reduces adjacent-passage duplication without adding a learned reranker.
